source.description: Initial marketing candidate rejected because an offline evaluation walkthrough member had feedback-only ingress.

candidate.title: Growth & Performance Marketing AI System
assumptions: Business domain: a growth marketing team running paid acquisition and retention campaigns across external ad networks, using first-party product analytics for outcome measurement.

Goal: continuously improve campaign performance by generating and adjusting copy, targeting, and conversion event definitions, and by reallocating budget to maximise conversions subject to CAC, budget, and brand constraints.

High-cost mutations (publishing campaigns, budget shifts above a threshold, new audience activation) require explicit human approval; low-risk variant drafts may proceed automatically within guardrails.
External ad platforms are reachable via their APIs, and first-party site/app event streams are available for attribution; copy generation uses a foundation model with versioned prompts.
Feedback from measured outcomes may update prompts, rankings, and live optimization configuration only through an offline-evaluated, reviewed release path.

components.label: Marketer Console
components.responsibility: Define growth objectives, constraints and budgets; review proposed copy, targeting, and event-definition changes; approve or reject high-cost mutations at the approval boundary.

components.label: Campaign Control API
components.responsibility: Intake objectives and approvals; orchestrate generation, experimentation, publish, evaluation, and release requests; persist campaign state; enforce approval gates before costly mutations.

components.label: Objective & Constraint Store
components.responsibility: Authoritative record of the optimization objective, budget and CAC guardrails, brand rules, and approval thresholds consulted by generation, optimization, and publishing.

components.label: Copy Generation Service
components.responsibility: Generate and adjust ad copy variants grounded in approved library assets and brand constraints; validate variants against policy before delivering them for experiment or publish.

components.label: Targeting & Event Definition Service
components.responsibility: Propose audience targeting and conversion event definitions; validate event schemas against analytics conventions before they are used in campaigns or attribution.

components.label: Creative & Learning Library
components.responsibility: Versioned store of approved copy, segments, event definitions, and validated learnings; manages reuse lifecycle and invalidates stale or underperforming assets.

components.label: Experimentation Service
components.responsibility: Design A/B tests and allocate traffic under significance guardrails; reserve experiment slots atomically before publish so retries cannot duplicate live tests.

components.label: Approval & Policy Gate
components.responsibility: Decision point routing costly mutations (publishes, budget shifts, new audiences) to marketer approval; records every decision and blocks auto-execution above thresholds.

components.label: Ad Platform Publisher
components.responsibility: Controlled execution of approved changes to ad platforms: reserve-before-send, atomic deduplication for retry-safe writes, reconciliation of platform state, and compensation (pause/revert) on failure.

components.label: Ad Network Platforms
components.responsibility: External search and social ad networks that serve campaigns, apply targeting and budgets, and report delivery, spend, and conversion data.

components.label: Product Event Sources
components.responsibility: Independent ingress of site and app conversion and engagement events used for attribution; not part of the marketer-initiated walkthrough.

components.label: Analytics & Attribution Pipeline
components.responsibility: Ingest and deduplicate outcome events; attribute conversions and revenue to copy variants, audiences, event definitions, and experiments for evaluation.

components.label: Outcome Evaluation Service
components.responsibility: Offline evaluation of variants and decision policies against curated evidence with acceptance thresholds; regression gate before any prompt, ranking, or configuration release.

components.label: Objective Optimizer
components.responsibility: Reallocate budget and select winning variants to maximise the constrained objective within guardrails; emit proposals, routing those above thresholds to the approval gate.

components.label: Learning Release Manager
components.responsibility: Reviewed release of feedback-driven updates to prompts, rankings, and live configuration: curated evidence, canary rollout, staged promotion, and rollback on regression.

components.label: Model & Prompt Registry
components.responsibility: Versioned registry of prompts, model selections, and ranking configurations with lineage to the evaluations that approved each version.

components.label: Audit & Reconciliation Log
components.responsibility: Immutable audit of approvals, publishes, reconciliations, compensations, and releases supporting accountability and recovery review.

components.label: Observability & Drift Monitor
components.responsibility: Monitor drift in outcomes and event quality, track latency and model/platform spend against budget, and alert or trigger safe degradation on anomalies.
